name: Candles
overview: Scripture presents candles and lamps as symbols of divine guidance, illumination, and the human spirit's connection to God. The candlestick made of pure gold in Exodus 25:31 and the continual burning of lamps with pure olive oil in Leviticus 24:2 emphasize the importance of light in worship and God's presence. Psalm 18:28 and Proverbs 20:27 highlight how God enlightens the believer's darkness and how the human spirit serves as His candle, searching the innermost parts of the heart. Additionally, Proverbs 24:20 reminds us that the light of the wicked will be extinguished, underscoring the moral and spiritual significance of this imagery.
